request.style: English, male baritone solo with gospel choir, piano, strings, drums, organ, hopeful and reverent, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The thirty-seventh year of exile passed
In the twelfth month when hope arrived
Evil-Merodach became king of Babylon
And the heavy chains were lifted high
He showed favor to the captive king
Who sat in darkness for so long

[Chorus]
He spoke kindly to him with grace
Gave a seat of honor in that place
Above the thrones of other kings
Jehoiachin heard the sweet things

[Verse]
The prison clothes were taken away
Restored to his dignity that day
He ate regularly at the royal table
For the rest of his life
The daily allowance was provided
In the land where he was exiled

[Chorus]
He spoke kindly to him with grace
Gave a seat of honor in that place
Above the thrones of other kings
Jehoiachin heard the sweet things

[Bridge]
From the shadows of the cell
To the light where the honor dwell
A glimmer of hope remains
In the memories of old days

[Outro]
Released from prison in the end
With kindness that we cannot mend
